description: Deploy Live Check — Checks a deploy three ways live — code head, running host, public site — and reports match or drift, with a walk-around to claimed vs live where there is no repo. Read-only, merges and deploys stay a human tap. (3 MESH/call, a tool · ops)

host.description: The running host (name or URL) for the running-host check.

repo.description: The repo (name or URL) for the code-head check — omit it when there is no repo and the walk-around runs instead.

site.description: REQUIRED — the public site URL of the deploy to check.

name: deploy-live-check
title: Deploy Live Check
